metaTitle: Custom Koozies with Carabiner | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom koozies with carabiner for easy carrying. Perfect for events, giveaways, and bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom koozies with carabiner add convenience to your branded drinkware. The attached clip lets recipients hook their koozie onto a backpack, belt loop, or cooler, keeping hands free at tailgates, trade shows, or job sites. Choose from neoprene or foam styles with full-color imprinting. A practical giveaway that stays visible all day.
